notes.title: Furniture Update!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41122883/3b12354319095e4b6e55c03180cce76dd25499f7.png
This update adds the ability to create your own interior, as well as various other improvements:

 Customization of the interior in your home!
 Added a new type of slimes
 Achievements added!
 The change of day and night now occurs correctly
 Many smaller fixes!

notes.title: Added tutorial
notes.content:
Added training in the journal section
 Other minor changes

notes.title: Slime Factory is out in Early Access!
notes.content:
I'm happy to announce that the first version of Slime Factory is now in Early Access!
And you can buy it with a 10% discount
